english:
Weapon Kills within 3 seconds progress a Counter. Progress per Kill is based on <link Enemy Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />:
• Rank-and-File and Elites: 34%
• Minibosses and above: 50%
• Guardians: 50%

Reaching 100% Counter Progress grants 40 Mobility for 7 seconds.

The buff can be refreshed by retriggering it.

source.text:
